channel.title: World News Live
channel.description: Daily news briefs: geopolitics, tech, sports, entertainment, business and world news, in our own words.

item.title: Trump, Xi and Putin Issue Four-Point Peace Declaration After Historic Summit
item.description: The leaders of the United States, China and Russia have issued a joint declaration on nuclear risk, UN reform, energy supplies and international courts after their first-ever three-way summit in Shenzhen.

item.title: World Court Rules Myanmar Committed Genocide Against the Rohingya
item.description: The International Court of Justice has ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya minority in 2017, the first time in the court's 80-year history that it has held a state responsible for the crime.

item.title: COP31 Draft Drops All Fossil Fuel References as Talks Near Deadline
item.description: A slimmed-down draft of the COP31 climate deal has removed every mention of coal, oil and gas, drawing condemnation from Pacific island nations as negotiators in Antalya race to reach agreement.

item.title: Cyclone Akvan Makes Landfall on Odisha-Andhra Coast After Mass Evacuations
item.description: Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan has begun crossing the coast between north Andhra Pradesh and south Odisha, with nearly three lakh people evacuated in Odisha and trains cancelled as the storm comes ashore.

item.title: Wall Street Sell-Off Deepens as S&P 500 Falls for a Sixth Straight Day
item.description: US stocks fell sharply on Thursday, with the S&P 500 logging its sixth straight loss and the Dow shedding 1,101 points, as even Anthropic's record debut failed to revive the AI trade.

item.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Neon, Its Middle-Weight AI Model for Coding and Science
item.description: Google has rolled out Gemini 4 Neon, a new model that sits between the fast Hydrogen and the flagship Carbon, promising near-flagship intelligence at a lower cost per task.

item.title: Nicholls' Unbeaten 175 Powers New Zealand to 368 Against India in Wellington
item.description: Henry Nicholls carried his bat for a magnificent unbeaten 175 and Glenn Phillips hit 118 as New Zealand recovered from 70 for 5 to post 368 in the first Test against India.

item.title: YouTube Trending Today: IShowSpeed's GTA VI Stream, Taylor Swift Live and Avengers: Doomsday
item.description: IShowSpeed's GTA VI early-access stream tops YouTube's trending chart with more than 64 million views, while Taylor Swift's CMA Awards performance and the Avengers: Doomsday trailer also surge.

item.title: Trump, Xi and Putin Meet in Shenzhen in First-Ever Three-Way Summit
item.description: The leaders of the United States, China and Russia are meeting in Shenzhen for the first three-way summit between the three countries, with nuclear arms control and the Iran war at the top of the agenda.

item.title: Anthropic Raises $81.3 Billion in the Biggest IPO in History
item.description: Anthropic, the company behind the Claude AI assistant, has priced its shares at $83 in a record $81.3 billion offering, valuing the firm at about $1.5 trillion ahead of its Nasdaq debut.

item.title: GTA VI Launches Worldwide After 13-Year Wait, With $1.54 Billion in Pre-Orders
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI goes on sale worldwide on Thursday, ending a 13-year wait, with pre-orders already worth an estimated $1.54 billion and employers bracing for a wave of sick days.

item.title: Voyager 1 Becomes the First Human-Made Object One Light-Day From Earth
item.description: NASA's Voyager 1 has reached a distance of about 16 billion miles from Earth, so far away that a radio signal now takes a full day to reach it — nearly 50 years after launch.

item.title: Hackers Used Optimizely Tool to Plant Malware on 178 Major Websites
item.description: Attackers abused a flaw in Optimizely's web testing tool to slip malicious code onto the sites of 178 organisations, including Zoom, the BBC, CNN and IKEA, skimming cards and swapping crypto wallets.

item.title: US and Venezuela Sign Deal to Re-Establish Military Ties
item.description: The United States and Venezuela have signed an agreement to re-establish military ties, covering training and intelligence sharing, in a striking turn for two long-time adversaries.

item.title: India and Canada Eye Defence Pact During Modi's December Visit
item.description: India and Canada could announce a defence agreement during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's official visit to Ottawa in December, a step that would mark a significant repair in the strained relationship.

item.title: YouTube Trending Today: GTA VI Streams, 'Avengers: Doomsday' Trailer and 'Yeh Prem Mol Liya' Lead
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI launch streams are sweeping YouTube on release day, while the 'Avengers: Doomsday' trailer and the Bollywood trailer 'Yeh Prem Mol Liya' are racing up the charts alongside them.

item.title: US Strikes IRGC Missile Site on Qeshm Island After Iran's Bahrain Drone Attack
item.description: The United States has hit a missile launch site on Qeshm Island in retaliation for an Iranian drone attack on an American base in Bahrain, in a sharp escalation around the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Ukraine Strikes Crimean Bridge for Second Day, Sending Road Span Into the Sea
item.description: Ukraine has hit the bridge linking Russia with occupied Crimea for a second straight day, collapsing a section of its road span into the Kerch Strait.

item.title: MS Dhoni Ends 18-Year IPL Career as Player, Takes Over as CSK Mentor
item.description: Mahendra Singh Dhoni has retired from playing in the Indian Premier League and will serve as Chennai Super Kings' team mentor from the 2027 season.

item.title: Modi Proposes Free E-Visas for ASEAN Tourists at Manila Summit
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has proposed free e-visas for tourists from ASEAN countries and a long-term maritime cooperation plan at the summit in Manila.
